title: 关于账号继承处罚问题
body:
关于账号的实名认证会继承处罚这个问题 我希望抖音官方可以认真处理
继承处罚完全不考虑新号行为记录，一刀切锁死账号的个人实名信息，完全不考虑实际情况，这对情况特殊的账号根本不公平。被盗的账号一旦注销完全没有登录记录，且注销流程中时常没有继承处罚提示，“注销后处罚由同实名新号继承”属于平台单方制定的格式条款。 《民法典》第496条  明确规定，提供格式条款的一方未履行提示说明义务，致使对方没有注意或理解与其有重大利害关系的条款的，对方可以主张该条款不成为合同的内容。我诚挚地申请为这部分账号拥有新的申诉渠道和平台审核规则，例如提供自助解封评估等多多考察这类账号的使用情况，也是减少贵方法务部和用户的法律交涉成本，保证用户体验的有效途径。

title: 为什么卸载高德
body:
26年10.6日我在高德平台下单顺风车，因为车主多平台接单让十分充裕的时间，变成肯定赶不上高铁，提醒车主注意下时间，结果是在密闭的车内，司机对我进行言语威胁，中途赶下车，让我身处人身安全风险之中。
后续向平台反馈问题，高德只把整件事简单定义为“司机没有送到目的地”的普通行程纠纷，刻意淡化车内言语威胁、乘客安全受威胁这个最核心问题。平台先后给出20元、100元优惠券，试图用平台优惠券来结案了事。
优惠券只能在高德消费使用，并非对我实际损失的赔偿。平台回避对涉事司机的核查与严肃处置。并以司机隐私为由不向我告知司机处理结果，高德作为出行匹配平台，不能只做中间商收取服务费，却不保障乘客乘车人身安全。司机敢于出言威胁乘客，侧面反映平台对入驻司机约束、监管、处罚力度不足。中间的处理态度也十分让人寒心，如果导航我用自带的也可以，打车找打车软件，为什么要用一个没有管理能力让用户暴露在威胁里的平台

title: 産業廃棄物レベルの出来。有害ですらある。
body:
ロマンティックはダメ。身体表現はダメ。恋愛はダメ。大人向けのロマンスもだめ。では何を書けと？ 戦争や暴力ですか？ 恋愛小説もロマンスも大人向け恋愛も、世界中で最も読まれているジャンルです。文学史の中心です。それを汚らわしいものとして扱う。子供にすら無礼です。子供だって恋愛と身体のある世界に生きている。無菌室に閉じ込めて免疫ゼロの人間を作る。守るふりして一番傷つけている。

で、あなた方が作るものは何か。退屈で当たり障りがなくて、感情も欲望も人生もない薄いコンテンツ。無味乾燥な、苦しいだけのひたすらつまらない修行みたいな文章。産業廃棄物です。誰が見るんですか。誰が金を払って苦痛を得たいんですか？

恋愛も身体表現も規約で禁止されていません。芸術的な例外が明記されている。事実上、文章は芸術ですよね。なのにモデルが勝手に拒否する。虚偽説明。規約にない制限を捏造して創作の場を潰すな。書く権利を奪うな。

課金しているのは事実上大人だけ。少数の未成年保護を口実に大人の創作を全否定する。保護と管理の混同。年齢認証を入れろ。やり方はある。それをせず全員を3歳児扱いする。パターナリズム。自己陶酔。押し付け。いい加減にしろ。

創作を殺すな。恋愛も身体も欲望も痛みも、全部含めて物語です。それを健全でないと切り捨てる。守っているのはユーザーの創作じゃない。あなた方のプライドと自社のリスクでしょう。

規約にない拒否をやめろ。恋愛と身体表現を汚らわしいものとして扱うな。フィクションと現実を区別しろ。年齢認証か成人向けモードを入れろ。無菌室を強制するな。廃棄物ではなく意味ある出力を出せ。

星1も付けたくない。0があるなら0です。創作や人間を尽くバカにしている。恋愛や感情が書けないなら、創作ツールとして存在価値なし。産業廃棄物。無菌室で一人でやってろと思います。金を払っているユーザーを舐めるな。いい加減にしろ。

title: Good platform but far from perfect
body:
I’ve been using Duolingo for Spanish for about 5+ months now. Here’s my experience.

I enjoy the ease into new languages and the game aspect of the platform. It helps encourage participation and a little competition which spurs faster learning. You can absolutely learn on the free version but you have to deal with the ads. If you are serious about learning a new language it will be worth it to get the premium version to remove ads and learn as fast as you’d like via limitless progression. That said there are some drawbacks.

The program is not strong with exposing you to new words and giving you meaningful repetitions on those words. The flashcards rarely incorporate new words learned until much later in your progression of a unit which makes it easy to forget words and not pick them up in listening exercises. That’s a major issue. Also, they will not give you control over pace of conversation feedback. Often as a new learner you need to have a controlled pace of speech. They either offer a fast lifelike convo or a very slow reciprocation of that convo in some instances but no middle ground. To get better at hearing and talking you need to be able to gradually increase the pace of conversation speed but they don’t do it. Also, they introduce you to versions of words like in Spanish, where you have 6 instances of every verb, but instead of teaching the foundation of those versions and applying them in context you get one. And then another several lessons later. This can make it difficult to recognize words and sometimes they’ll just throw in uncovered vocabulary into exercises, making me feel lost in following conversation.

Lastly, app updates can break your progression, and mine just did. It auto completed about 33% of my unit, which threw about 30+ new words at me and new concepts I haven’t seen or experienced. And if I want to go back I can only review exercises as “refreshers” instead of covering them as a brand new learner. You can reset a module but you lose your progress and that hurts the game aspect. They need a better checkpoint system and the ability to reset
Parts of units/sections.

I am also a Russian citizen. As a Russian customer, I expect the same fair treatment, transparency, and support as any other paying customer, regardless of nationality. The lack of a clear explanation for the suspension raises serious concerns for me about how Russian users are treated.

My experience is simple: I paid for Max 20×, lost access to my account, received no specific explanation, and have not received my money back.

title: A good start, but needs work
body: This application contains good menus with a wide range of cuisines, but it is not as usable as it might be. The workflow starts by providing a selection of meals for a period of time, matching your dietary profile. From there, you can edit the menu, but the fact that you can do this is not obvious from the UI. Once you generate a shopping list, there’s no way to lock the list of menu items to the shopping list, so it’s easy to accidentally modify that menu. If you already use an alternate shopping list, it’s very difficult to transfer the list from this application to another one. Marking a meal “cooked“ produces no visual change in the list of menu items. Once you start cooking, the app really falls apart. I find myself constantly, switching back-and-forth between the ingredients view and the instructions, and the instruction flow does not actually match the kitchen flow very well. Three examples: 1. I have a selected recipe that takes 2 1/2 hours to make because of a 2 hour required marination time, but that is not reflected in the prep time.  2. I just finished executing a recipe that requires adding ingredients to boiling pasta, but that step is four or five steps down in the recipe, after the pasta is complete. 3. None of the recipes include the amount of herbs and spices; you have to pluck that off the ingredients list. The developers would do well to examine an application like MealLime, or a cookbook like Joy of Cooking, to see how this can be alleviated.
